cohort: The study included brain histological samples from autopsies of 37 neonates and fetuses, some born to women with hypertension during pregnancy (n=22) and others to women without hypertension (n=15).
finding: Fetuses and neonates exposed to maternal hypertension during pregnancy showed increased cerebrovascular vulnerability, with a higher incidence of subarachnoid hemorrhage and other brain histological findings suggestive of injury.
birth_weight: Fetuses/neonates born to women with hypertension were found to be smaller.
gest_age: Gestational ages at delivery were matched between groups; however, fetuses/neonates born to women with hypertension had a lower gestational age at death.
